s: dakAraH । sa vyaYjanAzwAdaSavarRaH tavargatftIyavarRaSca । asyoccAraRasTAnaM dantaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA, SikzAyAm । 17 । “syurmUrdDanyA fwurazA dantyA xtulasAH smftAH ॥”) asya svarUpaM yaTA, -- “dakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! caturvvargapradAyakam । paYcadevamayaM varRaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA ॥ triSaktisahitaM devi ! trivindusahitaM sadA । AtmAditattvasaMyuktaM svayaM paramakuRqalI ॥ raktavidyullatAkAraM dakAraM hfdi BAvaya ॥” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ asya DyAnAdi yaTA, -- “DyAnamasya dakArasya vakzyate SfRu pArvvati ! । caturBujAM pItavastrAM navayOvanasaMsTitAm ॥ anekaratnaGawitahAranUpuraSoBitAm । evaM DyAtvA dakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” asya nAmAni yaTA, nAnAtantraSAstre । “do'drISo DAtakirDAtA dAtA dalaM kalatrakam । dInaM jYAnaYca dAnaYca BaktirAhavanI DarA ॥ suzumnA yoginI sadyaH kuRqalo vAmagulPakaH । kAtyAyanI SivA durgA laNGanA nA trikaRqakI ॥ svastikaH kuwilArUpaH kfzRaScomA jitendriyaH । DarmmahfdvAmadevaSca BramA bahusucaYcalA ॥ haridrApuramatrO ca dakzapARistrireKakaH ॥”

puM, (dE pa SudDO vA dA dAne + bAhulakAt kaH .) acalaH । dattaH । dAtA । iti medinI de, 1 ॥ (do cCede + qaH .) KaRqanam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 19 । 114 । “dAdadoduddaduddAdI dAdAdodUdadI dadoH । duddAdaM dadade dudde dadAdada dado'dadaH ॥” “dadyate iti dAdodAnam । dadadAne karmmaRi GaY । dAdaM dadAtIti dAdado dAnapradaH .” ityAdO mallinATakftawIkAyAmarTaviSezA bodDavyAH ॥)
v: dakAraH tavargIyatftIyavarRaH vyaYjanavarRaBedaH asyoccAraRasTAnaM dantamUlam । dantamUlena saha jihvAgreRa sparSanAdasya uccAryyatvAt sparSavarRatA । asyoccAraRe yAhyaBayatnAH saMvAranAdaGozA alpaprARaSca । tasya vAGakaSabdA varRABiDAnoktA yavA । “do'drISoDAtaki rDAtA dAtA trAsaH kalatrakam । dInaM jYAnaYca dAnaYca BaktirAvahanI DarA । suzumRA yoginI sadyaHkuntalo vAmagulPakaH । kAtyAyanI SivA durgA'naNganAmA trikaRwakI । svastikaH kuwilArUpaH kfzRaH SyAmA jitendriyaH । DarmakfdvAmadevaSca BramarehaH sucaYcalA । haridrApuravedI ca dakzapARistrireKakaH” SrasyADizWAtfdevatA DyAnAdi yaTA “DyAnamasya dakArasya vakzyate SfRu pArvati! । caturBujA pItavastrAM navayOvanasaMSritAma । anekaratnaGawitahAranupUraSoBitAm evaM DyAtva dakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet । triSaktisahitaM devi! trivindusahitaM taTA । AtmAditattvasaMyuktaM dakAraM praRamAnTaham” varRodDAratantram । asya svarUpaM yaTA “dakAraM SfRu cArvahi! baturvargapradAyakam । paYcadavamayaM varRaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA । triSaktisahitaM devi! trivindu sahitaM yadA । vyAtmAditattrasaMyaktaM svayaM paramakuRqalI । raktavidyullatAkAra wakari hfdi BAvayet” kAmaDenumantram । tAvyAdO asva prayoge sOKyaM Palam । doGaH sOKyaM mudaM naH” vftta॰ ra॰ wI॰ ukteH । mAvfkAnvAse'sya vAmagulPe nyAsyaH ।

pu॰ dEp--SudDo dA--dAne wo--KaRqane vA ka dada--dAne bA॰ qa vA । 1 parvate 2 datte 3 dAtari ca medi॰ । 4 kalatre na॰ ekAkzarakozaH । do--KaRqane sampa॰ BAve kvip । 5 KaRqane 6 rakzaRe ca strI medi॰ । “dAdadoduddaduddAdIdAdAdodUdadIdadoH । duddAdaM dadade duddedadAdadadado'dadaH” mAGaH asya mallinATavAKyAyAmarTa viSezA boDyAH । “smaraSApAvaDidAM sarasvatIm” kumA॰ “kariRAM mude sanaladA naladAH” kirA॰ । “syAdasyAnaladaM vinA na dalane tApasya ko'pi kzamaH” “de! vaHpatirviduvi nEzaDarAjagatyAH” nEzaDam । he viduzide vidvajjane dAtri! vo varuRaH iti varuRapakze cCedaH ।
m: 1. द the 3rd and soft letter of the 4th or dental class.

2. द mf(आ)n. (√ 1. दा) ifc. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 3) giving, granting, offering, effecting, producing (e.g. अभीष्ट-, ‘giving any desired object’, Pañcat. ii, 50; गज-वाजि-वृद्धि-, ‘promoting the welfare of elephants and horses’, VarBṛS. xviii, 5), Mn.; MBh. &c. (cf. अग्नि-; अ-दोम-द; अन्न-, अर्थ-, गर्भ-, जन्म- &c.)
द m. n. a gift, L.
3. द mfn. (√ दो) ifc. See अनल-, 2. जीव-
द m. n. the act of cutting off, L.
4. द mfn. (√ 4. द-) ifc. See ऋश्य-द.
द n. a wife (derived fr. दम्-पती), L.
a: द — a. (At the end of comp.) Giving, granting, producing, causing, cutting off, destroying, removing; as धनद, अन्नद, गरद, तोयद, अनलद &c. --दः 1 A gift, donation. --2 A mountain. --दं A wife. --दा 1 Heat. --2 Repentance.
